messages:
maria: Quick FYI — noticed the new concurrency shaper is causing extra chunking on embeddings requests for mixed-dim payloads. Console shows split_rate spike for route /v1/embeds :thinking:
ajay: Oof. Is that the softquota-based shaper we shipped in canary yesterday?
leo: Yep, that one. It reduces per-tenant concurrency when queued tokens exceed threshold. It might interact badly with the chunker that tries to balance bytes vs dims.
maria: Exactly. We're seeing small arrays (dim 1536) get forced into 2-3 chunks instead of staying single requests. Latency up ~30ms p50, cost up slightly.
nina: Any chance it's mis-classifying due to our preflight size estimate? We switched to approximate byte counts for speed.
ajay: Could be. The shaper decision runs before preflight normalization in the request path. If the shaper uses raw byte size and chunker uses normalized vector dims, mismatch happens.
maria: Proposed quick fixes: 1) move preflight earlier so shaper uses normalized size, or 2) tag requests with a preflight_hint header so shaper can consult same estimator. Thoughts?
leo: Preflight earlier sounds safer but touches hot path. Header seems less risky and faster to rollout. We can gate with a feature flag.
nina: If we add header, we should also emit telemetry fields: split_reason=shaper_intervention and preflight_hint_used=true. Need console dashboards for those metrics.
ajay: Agreed. Add a per-route split_rate graph and a tiny table: {route, split_rate, avg_chunks, p50_latency_delta}. Make it filterable by tenant.
maria: Also want an alert: split_rate increase >5% sustained 5m for critical customers. Could be a regression.
leo: Implementation plan: ops-bot will flip the header flag in canary for 50% of requests, monitor. If safe, rollout to 100% and then move preflight earlier in follow-up.
nina: I'll sketch the telemetry fields. Minimal set: preflight_hint_present, original_byte_estimate, normalized_batch_size, split_reason, shaper_decision, tenant_quota_bucket.
ajnay: tiny correction — tenant_quota_bucket name should be quota_tier. ops folks expect that label.
ajay: (typo above, ignore)
ops-bot: deploy-bot started rollout: canary flag embed_preflight_hint=true -> 10% of traffic to region-us-east-1.
maria: test curl for QA: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeds \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"input":["small vector ..."], "preflight_hint":"norm_v1"}'
```
leo: Nice. For console UX: add a small callout on route config: "Shaper-aware preflight is enabled" with a link to explain consequences and a toggle to preview.
nina: I'll add a mockup to the embed route page: split_rate sparkline + sample request inspector showing preflight_hint.
ajay: One more: instrument drop reasons to include "shaper_congestion" so we can attribute 413s vs splits.
maria: Good point. Ok let's do header+telemetry canary today, dashboard tile + alert in a follow-up. Who wants ownership?
leo: I'll own the shaper side (change and metric emission).
nina: I'll own console dashboard and mockups.
ajay: I'll handle rollout orchestration and alerts.
maria: Thanks! Please ping #incidents if any regression during canary. :eyes: 
deploy-bot: canary flag embed_preflight_hint=true rolled to 10% at 3467890150.
ops-bot: Observability: initial canary shows split_rate delta +0.6% (noise) and no customer-facing errors. Continuing 10% for 15m.
maria: Closing for now. Thanks team.
